bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
req=req_6ace20261122024500000014
python3 -B scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py "$req" --writer-ledger --writer-dir "$HOME/.local/state/gserver-terminal/results" >/dev/null
name=gace-host-output-$req
ids="$(gh api "repos/seigo-gace/TGserver/actions/artifacts?name=$name&per_page=30" --jq '.artifacts[] | select(.expired == false) | [.id,.workflow_run.id] | @tsv')"
count="$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -cE '^[0-9]+[[:space:]][0-9]+$' || true)"
test "$count" -eq 1 || exit 71
artifact_id="$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | awk '{print $1}')"
run_id="$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | awk '{print $2}')"
gh issue comment 351 --repo G-ACE-inc/server-core --body "PRIVATE_OUTPUT_LOCATOR request=$req private_run_id=$run_id private_artifact_id=$artifact_id (locator only)" >/dev/null
echo PRIVATE_ARTIFACT_LOCATOR_RECORDED=YES
